targets.note: On start, before the lock screen: Updating Vyre, the version it goes to, a thin bar with the real bytes and percent, and calm words.
The update waits for a reply running on this computer to finish before it stops the background service.
An install that failed: one line and Open Vyre anyway; the next start tries again.
The first open after an update: What's new in Vyre, the release's own lines, Continue. Once per version.
Automatic updates off and a newer version waiting: a quiet dot on the foot of the rail, where Settings is.
Settings, About Vyre: the version, the channel and when it last checked, Check now, Update available with Update now, Update Vyre automatically (off here), What's new.
